pr_title: Report correct max depth in exception message

issue_context.title: JsonSerializer reports the wrong max depth in exception message
issue_context.body:
The default value for `JsonSerializationOptions.MaxDepth` is 0, which is a special value meaning "use the default" (which is 64)

But when a cycle is detected, the error message reports that the max depth is 0, which is quite confusing. Since I didn't think I had a cycle in my object graph, I initially thought I had accidentally set the MaxDepth to 0.

> System.Text.Json.JsonException : A possible object cycle was detected which is not supported. This can either be due to a cycle or if the object depth is larger than the maximum allowed depth of 0.

It should probably report the *effective* max depth.
